mapper.sql: m.id, m.product_id, m.order_id, m.sender_id, sender.username as sender_name, m.receiver_id, receiver.username as receiver_name, m.content, m.create_time
mapper.select: select from tb_second_hand_message m left join tb_user sender on m.sender_id = sender.id left join tb_user receiver on m.receiver_id = receiver.id where m.deleted = 0 and m.product_id = #{productId} and (m.sender_id = #{userId} or m.receiver_id = #{userId}) order by m.create_time asc
